handle.name: Texture
handle.doc: Class representing a GPU texture resource.

handle.name: Buffer
handle.doc: Class representing a GPU buffer resource.

handle.name: Swapchain
handle.doc: Class representing a swapchain, which is a collection of render targets used for presentation.

handle.name: Surface
handle.doc: Class representing a GPU surface, which can be used as a target for rendering and presentation.

handle.name: ViewHeap
handle.doc: Class representing a storage for resource views used in contiguous array.

handle.name: Pipeline
handle.doc: Class representing a GPU pipeline state object, which encapsulates the state of the GPU pipeline and allows to execute draw and dispatch calls with it.

handle.name: Shader
handle.doc: Class representing a GPU shader module, which contains shader code and allows to create pipeline state objects with it.

handle.name: PipelineCache
handle.doc: Class representing a cache for pipeline state objects, which allows to reuse already created pipelines and speed up pipeline creation.

handle.name: DescriptorHeap
handle.doc: Class representing a storage for descriptors used in contiguous array.

handle.name: RootSignature
handle.doc: Class representing a pipeline layout and a constant data storage, which defines resource bindings for shaders.

handle.name: ResourceAllocator
handle.doc: Class for allocating and managing GPU resources like buffers and textures.

handle.name: Fence
handle.doc: Class representing a fence for GPU-CPU and GPU-GPU synchronization.

handle.name: CommandList
handle.doc: Class representing a command list for recording GPU commands.

handle.name: CommandAllocator
handle.doc: Class representing a pool allocator for command lists for recording GPU commands.

handle.name: CommandQueue
handle.doc: Class representing a command queue for submitting command lists to the GPU.

handle.name: AdapterQuery
handle.doc: Class that contains a snapshot of adapters that are present on the system.

func.name: CreateInstance
func.doc: Creates the {Instance::} with extensions, specified in extension array.

ret.name: instance
ret.doc: points to {Instance::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: debug_desc
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {DebugDesc::}, which defines debug callback and debug layer usage. If `nullptr`, debug layer is disabled.

arg.name: extensions
arg.doc: points to an array of extensions that are to be initialized with pointers to {InstanceExtensionHeader::}.

arg.name: extension_count
arg.doc: describes the number of the number of extensions in the {CreateInstance::extensions} array.

func.name: QueryAdapters
func.doc: Queries all the system adapters and allows to iterate through them. The order of adapters depends on `preference`: for MinConsumption - DirectX 12: Integrated, Discrete, External, Software; Vulkan: Integrated GPU, Discrete GPU, Virtual GPU, CPU. For Performance - DirectX 12: External, Discrete, Integrated, Software; Vulkan: Discrete GPU, Integrated GPU, Virtual GPU, CPU.

ret.name: query
ret.doc: points to {AdapterQuery::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: preference
arg.doc: indicates the order in which adapters are listed.

func.name: GetAdapterCount
func.doc: Returns the number of adapters present on the system at the time of the query.

ret.name: count
ret.doc: is a number of adapters present on the system.

func.name: GetAdapterDesc
func.doc: Returns the description of the adapter at given index.

ret.name: desc
ret.doc: points to {AdapterDesc::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index of the adapter to get the description for. It @wis_must be less than the value returned by {AdapterQuery::GetAdapterCount}.

func.name: GetSurfaceSupport
func.doc: Checks if the adapter at given index supports presentation to given surface.

ret.name: supported
ret.doc: `true` if the adapter supports presentation to the surface, `false` otherwise.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index of the adapter to check the support for. It @wis_must be less than the value returned by {AdapterQuery::GetAdapterCount}.

arg.name: surface
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Surface::} to check the presentation support for.

func.name: CreateDevice
func.doc: Creates the device for the adapter at given index.

ret.name: device
ret.doc: points to {Device::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index of the adapter to create the device for. It @wis_must be less than the value returned by {AdapterQuery::GetAdapterCount}.

arg.name: requirements
arg.doc: defines a pointer to {DeviceRequirements::}, which defines required features and properties for device creation.

func.name: CreateCommandQueue
func.doc: Creates a command queue of given type.

ret.name: queue
ret.doc: points to {CommandQueue::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: type
arg.doc: specifies the type of the command queue to create.

func.name: CreateCommandAllocator
func.doc: Creates a command allocator to allocate command lists with.

ret.name: allocator
ret.doc: points to {CommandAllocator::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: type
arg.doc: specifies the type of the command list this pool is able to allocate.

func.name: CreateFence
func.doc: Creates a fence for GPU-CPU and GPU-GPU synchronization.

ret.name: fence
ret.doc: points to {Fence::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: initial_value
arg.doc: specifies the initial value of the fence.

func.name: GetResourceAllocator
func.doc: Creates a resource allocator for managing GPU resources.

ret.name: allocator
ret.doc: points to {ResourceAllocator::}, which is initialized on success.

func.name: CreateRootSignature
func.doc: Creates a pipeline layout with given descriptor.

ret.name: layout
ret.doc: points to {RootSignature::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {RootSignatureDesc::}, which describes the pipeline layout to create.

func.name: CreateDescriptorHeap
func.doc: Creates a descriptor storage with given description.

ret.name: heap
ret.doc: points to {DescriptorHeap::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {DescriptorHeapDesc::}, which describes the descriptor heap to create.

func.name: CreateViewHeap
func.doc: Creates a view storage with given descriptor.

ret.name: heap
ret.doc: points to {ViewHeap::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: type
arg.doc: specifies the type of the view heap to create.

arg.name: capacity
arg.doc: specifies the capacity in descriptors of the view heap to create.

func.name: QueryProperties
func.doc: Queries the properties of the device.

arg.name: properties
arg.doc: describes a pointer to one of the query structs, which is filled with device properties.

func.name: WaitForMultipleFences
func.doc: Waits on multiple fences simultaneously. If wait_for is {MultiWaitType::All}, waits for all fences to be signaled. Otherwise waits for any fence to be signaled.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: fences
arg.doc: defines an array of fence views to wait on.

arg.name: fence_values
arg.doc: defines fence values to wait for; array @wis_must have fence_count values.

arg.name: fence_count
arg.doc: describes number of fences to wait on.

arg.name: wait_for
arg.doc: indicates the kind of wait, where All waits for all fences and Any waits for any fence; default is {MultiWaitType::All}.

arg.name: timeout
arg.doc: indicates timeout in nanoseconds; if UINT64_MAX, waits indefinitely.

func.name: CreatePipelineCache
func.doc: Creates a pipeline cache for caching pipeline state objects.

ret.name: cache
ret.doc: points to {PipelineCache::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: initial_data
arg.doc: points to an array of initial cache data bytes. If `nullptr`, the cache is created empty.

arg.name: data_size
arg.doc: defines the size of the initial cache data in bytes.

func.name: CreateShader
func.doc: Creates a shader module from given data.

ret.name: shader
ret.doc: points to {Shader::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: points to an array of shader bytecode.

arg.name: size
arg.doc: indicates size of shader data in bytes; for SPIR-V it @wis_must be a multiple of 4.

func.name: CreateComputePipeline
func.doc: Creates a compute pipeline state object with given descriptor.

ret.name: pipeline
ret.doc: points to {Pipeline::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {ComputePipelineDesc::}, which describes the compute pipeline to create.

func.name: CreateGraphicsPipeline
func.doc: Creates a graphics pipeline state object with given descriptor.

ret.name: pipeline
ret.doc: points to {Pipeline::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {GraphicsPipelineDesc::}, which describes the graphics pipeline to create.

func.name: GetFormatPresentationSupport
func.doc: Checks if the surface format is supported for presentation and returns the supported format.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: surface
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Surface::} to check the presentation support for.

arg.name: format
arg.doc: describes the format to check the presentation support for.

func.name: GetSurfaceParameters
func.doc: Gets presentation parameters for the specified surface.

ret.name: params
ret.doc: Parameters of the surface.

arg.name: surface
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Surface::} to check the presentation support for.

func.name: CreateSwapchain
func.doc: Creates a swapchain for given surface with given descriptor.

ret.name: swapchain
ret.doc: points to {Swapchain::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: surface
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Surface::} to create the swapchain for. Surface is ref-counted.

arg.name: queue
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {CommandQueue::} to create the swapchain for. Queue is ref-counted and @wis_must be a graphics queue.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {SwapchainDesc::}, which describes the swapchain to create.

func.name: GetCompletedValue
func.doc: Get the current value of the fence.

ret.name: value
ret.doc: Value of the fence.

func.name: Wait
func.doc: Wait on CPU for the fence to reach a certain value.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: value
arg.doc: describes value to wait for.

arg.name: wait_ns
arg.doc: describes the time to wait for the fence to reach the value in nanoseconds. Default is infinite.

func.name: Signal
func.doc: Signal the fence from CPU.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: value
arg.doc: describes value to signal.

func.name: Submit
func.doc: Executes the command lists.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: lists
arg.doc: points to an array of command lists to execute.

arg.name: list_count
arg.doc: defines number of command lists to execute.

func.name: SignalFence
func.doc: Enqueue the signal to the queue, that gets executed after all the work has been done.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: fence
arg.doc: describes fence to signal.

arg.name: value
arg.doc: describes value used to signal the fence.

func.name: WaitFence
func.doc: Enqueues wait operation to the command queue. Queue then waits for the fence to be signalled from CPU or from another queue. Can still be enqueued after the signal.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: fence
arg.doc: describes fence to wait on.

arg.name: value
arg.doc: describes value that the fence is expected to reach.

func.name: CreateBuffer
func.doc: Creates a buffer with given descriptor.

ret.name: buffer
ret.doc: points to {Buffer::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {BufferDesc::}, which describes the buffer to create.

func.name: CreateTexture
func.doc: Creates a texture with given descriptor.

ret.name: texture
ret.doc: points to {Texture::}, which is initialized on success.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {TextureDesc::}, which describes the texture to create.

func.name: Map
func.doc: Maps the buffer memory to CPU accessible address space.

ret.name: data
ret.doc: points to the pointer, which is filled with the address of the mapped memory on success.

func.name: GetGPUAddress
func.doc: Gets the GPU virtual address of the buffer.

ret.name: address
ret.doc: Address of the buffer on GPU.

func.name: WriteSubresource
func.doc: Writes data directly to the texture subresource. Texture @wis_must be in {TextureState::Common} and @wis_must_not be a depth texture.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: source_data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to the data to write to the texture.

arg.name: target_region
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {TextureRegion::}, which describes the region of the texture to write to.

func.name: GetCPUHandle
func.doc: Returns the CPU descriptor handle for the descriptor heap.

ret.name: handle
ret.doc: CPU descriptor handle for the descriptor heap.

func.name: WriteConstantBuffer
func.doc: Writes {DescriptorType::ConstantBuffer} descriptor to the descriptor heap.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {ConstantBufferBinding::}, which describes the constant buffer descriptors to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the descriptor heap to write the descriptors to.

func.name: WriteStructuredBuffer
func.doc: Writes {DescriptorType::Buffer} descriptor to the descriptor heap.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: buffer
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {Buffer::} to write the descriptor for.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {BufferBinding::}, which describes the shader resource view descriptors to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the descriptor heap to write the descriptors to.

func.name: WriteRWStructuredBuffer
func.doc: Writes {DescriptorType::RWBuffer} descriptor to the descriptor heap.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: buffer
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {Buffer::} to write the descriptor for.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {BufferBinding::}, which describes the shader resource view descriptors to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the descriptor heap to write the descriptors to.

func.name: WriteSampler
func.doc: Writes {DescriptorType::Sampler} descriptor to the descriptor heap.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: sampler
arg.doc: defines a pointer to {SamplerDesc::}, which describes the sampler descriptor to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the descriptor heap to write the descriptor to.

func.name: WriteTexture
func.doc: Writes a descriptor to the descriptor heap.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: texture
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Texture::} to write the descriptor for.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {TextureBinding::}, which describes the texture view to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the descriptor heap to write the descriptor to.

func.name: WriteRWTexture
func.doc: Writes a texture view to the descriptor heap.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: texture
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Texture::} to write the descriptor for.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {TextureBinding::}, which describes the texture view to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the descriptor heap to write the descriptor to.

func.name: WriteAccelerationStructure
func.doc: Writes a raytracing acceleration to the descriptor heap.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: address
arg.doc: specifies GPU address of a raytracing acceleration structure.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the descriptor heap to write the descriptor to.

func.name: CopyDescriptors
func.doc: Copies descriptors from one heap to another.

arg.name: dst_index
arg.doc: specifies the index in the destination descriptor heap to copy descriptors to.

arg.name: src_ptr
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {DescriptorHeap::} to copy descriptors from. Source heap @wis_must be CPU Only heap.

arg.name: src_index
arg.doc: indicates the index in the source descriptor heap to copy descriptors from.

arg.name: descriptor_count
arg.doc: indicates the number of descriptors to copy.

func.name: WriteRenderTarget
func.doc: Writes a render target view to the view heap and returns the CPU descriptor handle for it.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: CPU descriptor handle for the view heap.

arg.name: texture
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Texture::} to write the descriptor for.

arg.name: render_target
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {RenderTargetDesc::}, which describes the render target view to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the view heap to write the descriptor to.

func.name: WriteDepthStencil
func.doc: Writes a depth stencil view to the view heap and returns the CPU descriptor handle for it.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: CPU descriptor handle for the view heap.

arg.name: texture
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {Texture::} to write the descriptor for.

arg.name: render_target
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {RenderTargetDesc::}, which describes the depth stencil view to write.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the view heap to write the descriptor to.

func.name: GetViewAddress
func.doc: Returns the CPU descriptor handle for the view heap.

ret.name: view
ret.doc: Address of a view in heap.

arg.name: index
arg.doc: defines the index in the view heap to get the descriptor from.

func.name: CopyViews
func.doc: Copies views from one heap to another.

arg.name: dst_index
arg.doc: specifies the index in the destination view heap to copy views to.

arg.name: src_ptr
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {ViewHeap::} to copy views from.

arg.name: src_index
arg.doc: indicates the index in the source view heap to copy views from.

arg.name: view_count
arg.doc: indicates the number of views to copy.

func.name: GetCPUHandle
func.doc: Returns the CPU descriptor handle for the view heap.

ret.name: handle
ret.doc: CPU descriptor handle for the view heap.

func.name: Reset
func.doc: Resets the command allocator, so it can be reused for allocating new command lists.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

func.name: CreateCommandList
func.doc: Creates a command list of given type.

ret.name: list
ret.doc: points to {CommandList::}, which is initialized on success.

func.name: Begin
func.doc: Opens the command list, so commands can be recorded to it.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

func.name: End
func.doc: Closes the command list, so it can be executed on the command queue.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

func.name: SetDescriptorHeaps
func.doc: Binds descriptor heaps to the command list, so they can be used for resource binding.

arg.name: resource_heap
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {DescriptorHeap::} with shader resource views, unordered access views and constant buffer views. If `nullptr`, no resource heap is bound.

arg.name: sampler_heap
arg.doc: describes a pointer to {DescriptorHeap::} with samplers. If `nullptr`, no sampler heap is bound.

func.name: SetRootSignature
func.doc: Sets the root signature for the command list, so it can be used for resource binding.

arg.name: signature
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {RootSignature::} to set.

arg.name: pipeline
arg.doc: specifies the pipeline type to set the root signature for.

func.name: SetPushConstants
func.doc: Sets the push constants for the command list, so they can be used for resource binding.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {PushConstantSetDesc::}, which describes the push constant data to set.

func.name: SetPushDescriptor
func.doc: Sets the push descriptors for the command list, so they can be used for resource binding.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {PushDescriptorSetDesc::}, which describes the push descriptors to set.

func.name: SetDescriptorTable
func.doc: Sets the descriptor table offset in descriptor heap for the command list, so it can be used for resource binding.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: specifies the root parameter index to set the descriptor table for.

func.name: InsertBarriers
func.doc: Inserts one or more barriers on the current command list.

arg.name: barriers
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to an array of barriers to insert.

func.name: SetPipeline
func.doc: Sets the pipeline state object for the command list, so it can be used for draw and dispatch calls.

arg.name: pipeline
arg.doc: specifies a pointer to {Pipeline::} to set.

arg.name: type
arg.doc: specifies the pipeline type to set the pipeline for.

func.name: SetViewports
func.doc: Sets multiple viewports.

arg.name: viewports
arg.doc: points to an array of viewports to set.

arg.name: viewport_count
arg.doc: defines number of viewports to set.

func.name: SetScissors
func.doc: Sets multiple scissor rects. Each n-th rect corresponds to n-th Viewport set in RSSetViewports if SV_ViewportArrayIndex is used in geometry shader. Otherwise the first is chosen.

arg.name: scissor_rects
arg.doc: points to an array of scissor rectangles to set.

arg.name: rect_count
arg.doc: specifies number of scissor rectangles to set.

func.name: SetPrimitiveTopology
func.doc: Sets the primitive topology. Determines how vertices shall be processed.

arg.name: topology
arg.doc: describes primitive topology to set.

func.name: SetDepthBias
func.doc: Sets the depth bias. Determines how depth values are modified during rasterization.

arg.name: depth_bias
arg.doc: indicates depth bias to set.

arg.name: depth_bias_clamp
arg.doc: indicates depth bias clamp to set.

arg.name: slope_scaled_depth_bias
arg.doc: defines slope-scaled depth bias to set.

func.name: SetPrimitiveRestartValue
func.doc: Sets the primitive restart value. Determines the index value which is treated as a primitive restart when using indexed draw calls.

arg.name: restart_value
arg.doc: describes primitive restart value to set.

func.name: Dispatch
func.doc: Dispatches compute shader.

arg.name: group_count_x
arg.doc: defines number of groups to dispatch in X dimension.

arg.name: group_count_y
arg.doc: describes number of groups to dispatch in Y dimension; default is 1.

arg.name: group_count_z
arg.doc: specifies number of groups to dispatch in Z dimension; default is 1.

func.name: Draw
func.doc: Draws non-indexed geometry.

arg.name: vertex_count
arg.doc: specifies number of vertices to draw.

arg.name: instance_count
arg.doc: describes number of instances to draw; default is 1.

arg.name: start_vertex
arg.doc: indicates index of the first vertex to draw; default is 0.

arg.name: start_instance
arg.doc: specifies index of the first instance to draw; default is 0.

func.name: DrawIndexed
func.doc: Draws indexed geometry.

arg.name: index_count
arg.doc: defines number of indices to draw.

arg.name: instance_count
arg.doc: describes number of instances to draw; default is 1.

arg.name: start_index
arg.doc: describes index of the first index to draw; default is 0.

arg.name: base_vertex
arg.doc: defines value added to each index before reading a vertex from the vertex buffer; default is 0.

arg.name: start_instance
arg.doc: specifies index of the first instance to draw; default is 0.

func.name: BeginRenderPass
func.doc: Begins a render pass with given descriptor.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {RenderPassDesc::}, which describes the render pass to begin.

func.name: EndRenderPass
func.doc: Ends the current render pass.

func.name: CopyBuffer
func.doc: Copies regions from one buffer to another.

arg.name: dst_buffer
arg.doc: defines a pointer to the destination buffer.

arg.name: src_buffer
arg.doc: describes a pointer to the source buffer.

arg.name: regions
arg.doc: points to an array of {BufferCopyRegion::} that defines the copy regions.

arg.name: region_count
arg.doc: defines the count of the regions.

func.name: Serialize
func.doc: Gets the data from the pipeline cache.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: data
arg.doc: points to an array that is filled with serialized cache data on success.

arg.name: data_size
arg.doc: defines the size of the data chunk in bytes. It @wis_must be greater or equal to the value returned by {PipelineCache::GetSerializedSize}.

func.name: GetSerializedSize
func.doc: Gets the size of the data in the pipeline cache.

ret.name: size
ret.doc: Size of the data in bytes.

func.name: Present
func.doc: Presents the swapchain image to the screen.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: flags
arg.doc: describes the presentation options.

arg.name: rects
arg.doc: points to an array of rectangles to present. If `nullptr`, the entire image is presented.

arg.name: rect_count
arg.doc: specifies the number of rectangles to present. It @wis_must be 0 if rects is `nullptr`.

func.name: GetCurrentIndex
func.doc: Gets the index of the current backbuffer. In case of lazy indexing it may wait for presentation to finish and block.

ret.name: index
ret.doc: Index of the current backbuffer.

func.name: Update
func.doc: Resizes the swapchain buffers. If the swapchain is currently in use, it @wis_must be resized after the GPU finishes using it, so the call may block until then.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: desc
arg.doc: indicates a pointer to {SwapchainUpdateDesc::}, which describes the new swapchain parameters.

func.name: GetTextures
func.doc: Gets the swapchain buffers. The textures are in {TextureState::Common}.

ret.name: result
ret.doc: Result of operation.

arg.name: buffers
arg.doc: points to an array of texture views, which are filled with swapchain backbuffers on success.

arg.name: buffer_count
arg.doc: specifies the number of buffers to get. It @wis_must be greater or equal to the value, supplied to {SwapchainDesc::image_count} or subsequent {SwapchainUpdateDesc::image_count}.
